interpretation.normalMemoryHighClocks: All three requested transitions reset before switchClock returned. No independent high-frequency measurement or song CPU measurement obtained. This is a failure of the tested transition/method on this board, not a proved CPU frequency ceiling.
interpretation.control: 240 MHz completed the identical harness and 12 s song window, then deliberately rebooted. Guard-drop delta and DMA-underrun delta both zero.
interpretation.slowMemory: 320 MHz with doubled flash/PSRAM dividers also reset before a measured speed or canary result. Flash/RAM would nominally be ~53.3 MHz with PLL640 and core divider unchanged; actual pin clocks were not measured and active register capture was not reached.
interpretation.crashEvidence: New summaries after standard 300/280 refer to trial ELF 2348941bb, including cache-resume/panic paths; old summaries after 320 attempts are not evidence of a fresh dump. Normal 240 reboot is deliberate, high-clock resets are not.
interpretation.wifiEvents: First harness counted disconnects through reboot; baseline reason8 may be deliberate restart, not a clock-window Wi-Fi failure. The second harness restricts events to high-clock stages. No successful high-clock window means no new RF conclusion.
interpretation.notes: First harness preserves existing guard900; control observed zero guard drops. Second harness temporarily sets guard0 so overload cannot discard notes. No permanent voice/quality setting changes.
